explication: Cloud Run MCP exposes project and service-management tools plus deployment and log prompts to AI clients. The principal workflow is an agent tool call through MCP registration into deployment orchestration, which prepares source or an image and deploys a Cloud Run service; separate tools list projects and inspect services/logs. The README documents local-folder, file-content, and image deployment, and local project creation. The sampled sources establish several orchestration calls, but not every internal deployment step, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
